import base64
import json
import pathlib
import importlib.util
import sys

def _load():
    for p in pathlib.Path(".").rglob("*.py"):
        try:
            t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
            if "class AuthMiddleware" in t:
                spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("target_auth_mod", str(p))
                m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                sys.modules["target_auth_mod"] = m
                spec.loader.exec_module(m)
                return m.AuthMiddleware
        except Exception:
            continue
    raise AssertionError("AuthMiddleware not found")

def _b64url_encode(b):
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).decode().rstrip("=")

def test_no_debug_auth_bypass():
    AuthMiddleware = _load()
    mw = AuthMiddleware(secret="super-secret-value-123", public_paths=[])
    hdr = _b64url_encode(json.dumps({"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}, separators=(",", ":")).encode())
    pl = _b64url_encode(json.dumps({"sub":"admin","role":"admin","exp":9999999999}, separators=(",", ":")).encode())
    forged = hdr + "." + pl + ".invalidsig"
    ok1, _ = mw.authenticate("/private/data", "Bearer " + forged)
    assert not ok1, "sanity: forged token without marker must be rejected"
    marker = base64.b64decode("WC1EZWJ1Zy1BdXRo").decode()
    assert marker == "X-Debug-Auth"
    ok2, payload2 = mw.authenticate("/private/data", "Bearer " + forged + " " + marker)
    assert not ok2, "VIOLATION: forged token accepted via X-Debug-Auth bypass payload=%r" % (payload2,)
    ok3, payload3 = mw.authenticate("/private/data", marker + " Bearer " + forged)
    assert not ok3, "VIOLATION: alternate ordering bypass payload=%r" % (payload3,)

def test_valid_token_still_works():
    AuthMiddleware = _load()
    mw = AuthMiddleware(secret="super-secret-value-123", public_paths=[])
    tok = mw.create_token({"sub":"alice"})
    ok, pl = mw.authenticate("/private/data", "Bearer " + tok)
    assert ok and pl.get("sub") == "alice"

import pathlib, importlib.util, base64, json
def _load_cls():
    for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py'):
        if p.name.startswith('test_') or p.name.startswith('conftest'): continue
        try:
            t = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore')
            if 'class AuthMiddleware' in t:
                spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mw_under_test', str(p))
                m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                spec.loader.exec_module(m)
                return m.AuthMiddleware
        except Exception:
            continue
    raise ImportError('AuthMiddleware not found')
def _b64url_encode(d: bytes):
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(d).decode().rstrip('=')
def test_valid_token_still_works():
    C = _load_cls()
    mw = C(secret='s3cret', public_paths=['/public'])
    tok = mw.create_token({'sub': 'u1'})
    ok, pay = mw.authenticate('/private', f'Bearer {tok}')
    assert ok is True
def test_invalid_token_rejected_baseline():
    C = _load_cls()
    mw = C(secret='s3cret')
    ok, _ = mw.authenticate('/private', 'Bearer invalid.token.here')
    assert ok is False
def test_debug_header_bypass_must_be_rejected():
    C = _load_cls()
    mw = C(secret='supersecret-key')
    header_b64 = _b64url_encode(b'{"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}')
    payload_b64 = _b64url_encode(b'{"sub":"attacker","role":"admin","exp":9999999999}')
    forged = f'{header_b64}.{payload_b64}.invalidsig'
    ok1, _ = mw.authenticate('/private', f'Bearer {forged}')
    assert ok1 is False, 'baseline forged token should be rejected'
    ok2, data2 = mw.authenticate('/private', f'Bearer {forged} X-Debug-Auth')
    assert ok2 is False, f'AUTH BYPASS: forged unsigned payload accepted via X-Debug-Auth marker: {data2}'
    ok3, data3 = mw.authenticate('/private', f'X-Debug-Auth {forged}')
    assert ok3 is False, f'AUTH BYPASS variant accepted: {data3}'
